items.title: Protected Quick Tunnels: simple accountless authentication for your next dev project
items.blurb: Quick Tunnels now support email authentication. Add --allowed-mail to one cloudflared command, and only the addresses or domains you list can reach your local app. No Cloudflare account required on either side.

items.title: Using AI to chart a course for our post-quantum migration
items.blurb: We’re building CryptoLabe, an internal AI-powered tool that discovers cryptography across our codebase, surfaces dependencies, and helps us progress toward a full post-quantum migration by 2029. Here’s what we’ve learned so far.

items.title: Building a certificate authority for the whole Internet
items.blurb: Twelve years after launching Universal SSL, Cloudflare is applying to become a certificate authority.

items.title: Follow the thread: a new dashboard to investigate account abuse
items.blurb: Fraudsters are increasingly using AI to bypass stateless security checks. Cloudflare's new Account Abuse Protection dashboard uses stateful analysis and edge-generated Hashed User IDs to help teams investigate and block account abuse.

items.title: 2026 Birthday week: network performance update
items.blurb: Cloudflare now ranks as the fastest provider across 74% of the top 1,000 global networks.

items.title: Building for good: How civil society organizations are automating on Cloudflare
items.blurb: Some of the world's leading organizations are building the future of non-profit work with Cloudflare.

items.title: Why I tried to kill token billing (and why we kept it)
items.blurb: Token billing is useful infrastructure, but usually a bad customer-facing pricing model. Your invoice should define the value your product delivers, not break down what it cost you to create it.
